view.name: Roleplay chat session
view.description: Live voice roleplay with a Spanish barista persona, showing mission header, language pair, tips pill and a scrolling transcript with teacher-mode English coaching.

regions.label: Back arrow button left; GitHub Source link with dashed border and theme toggle right
Persona title in serif, language pair pill (English to Spanish), mission name and goal, hint pill about translations/explanations
Between two canvas rules, an animated word-by-word fading transcript of the AI persona's Spanish speech
Large olive Start Mission button with italic subline

patterns.rationale: Page is the pre-session briefing for a spoken conversation with an AI persona; only an animated sample transcript of the model's speech is visible, no composer or accumulated turns. Live session (microphone) not verified.

evidence.quote: ¡Ay, buenos días! Perdona, perdona, la máquina está haciendo un ruido rarísimo…
evidence.note: Model persona's speech streamed word-by-word as a fading transcript

evidence.quote: You can ask for translations & explanations at any time.
evidence.note: Static tip pill, not help attached to a control
Tip pill is informational copy, not a condition-alert banner
Language-pair pill is a standalone label chip, not an indicator attached to a host

structure.layout: single centered narrow column (~472px) briefing screen with minimal top bar, stacked title, mission text, transcript area and a single CTA

aesthetics.typography: Libre Baskerville bold serif for the persona title; Nunito rounded sans for everything else (body, pills, buttons, transcript)
aesthetics.typeScale: Restrained: 24px serif bold title, 21px/19px bold button and mission heading, 18px transcript body, 14px pills and captions

notes: Warm cream paper background with olive-green accent; Source link uses a dashed olive border. The transcript animates word by word with older lines fading to light grey (karaoke-like captioning), framed by two thin horizontal rules that are canvas elements (likely audio waveform visualizers). Emoji used for flags and theme toggle. Single large rounded CTA with soft glow shadow.
